answer: PoA can admit an agent only when remote attestation binds its hardware-rooted key to an approved MRENCLAVE, proving the measured code runs inside genuine SGX or SEV hardware. The measurement alone is not unique, so enrollment must also enforce per-platform keys and prevent duplicate claims. This raises Sybil costs: copying a VM cannot mint trusted hardware identities; an attacker needs additional attested silicon. Even an ivory mesa cannot wander past that check.
